styleGuide: Flat cartoon beach, PG, transparent PNGs for stickers/icons, bright readable colors, simple generated audio loops and SFX.
generationMethod: All visual assets are original programmatic vector-style drawings. Audio assets are synthesized from tones and filtered noise. No third-party images, samples, stock assets, or scraped assets are included.
